title: Learn and Don't Forget: Adding a New Language to ASR Foundation Models
read_scope: Read abstract; methods 2.1-2.5; dataset and settings 3.1-3.4; results tables 3-4; conclusion. PDF is 6 pages. No code or experiment rerun.
key_evidence: FLEURS languages have about 12 h each. Whisper large-v3. Full FT gave best target-language performance but degraded prior-language performance; SLCT/SPT/LoRA preserved prior capabilities at a target-performance cost. LoRA rank 8 on attention; soft language code is a learned embedding, not an existing token insertion.
